purpose: Four two-color refinements of the selected Swarm icon; preview only

variants.name: Ember
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied sculpted turquoise Swarm desktop-app icon for hgs zerus.
Create a TWO-COLOR refinement of THIS EXACT ICON. Preserve the exact original form: three large curved outer blades, three smaller inner crescent blades, the open center, all spacing, the direction of rotation, all bevels, lighting and the square composition. Do not redesign the emblem or move any piece.
The three LARGE OUTER blades must remain luminous sculpted TURQUOISE, base color #20C7BC, deep teal shaded faces, pale mint highlights. Change ONLY the material color of all THREE SMALL INNER CRESCENT BLADES to the contrasting accent specified below. These inner blades must be saturated, clearly separate and bright enough to be unmistakably a SECOND COLOR even when the image is small. Color the full face and its bevels, not just a thin rim. Keep their real rounded sculptural depth and the same satin material finish as the outer blades.
Background: preserve the smooth dark graphite-teal #142329 background edge to edge, including between the shapes. Fully OPAQUE square image; no alpha, no drawn rounded rectangle or frame. Clean immaculate antialiased contours, absolutely no particles, colored specks, fringes or outside halos. No added symbols, typography or watermarks. No purple or violet anywhere. A single finished app icon, not a presentation board. Only the specified inner-blade material colors change; geometry and overall framing remain invariant.
Accent A — CORAL / EMBER: color all three inner crescent blades vivid hot coral-orange #FF6552, with warm vermilion shadow faces and peach highlights. Strong complementary cool turquoise against warm coral. Broad clearly orange-red faces, not pink or purple.

refinements.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: this existing finished app icon with THREE WHITE INNER CRESCENT INSERTS and three TURQUOISE OUTER BLADES on a dark background.
Change the color of ONLY the THREE WHITE PIECES. Leave every turquoise surface, the entire dark background, all geometry, highlights, framing and bevels unchanged.
The three white pieces are: (1) the curved insert in the upper-right area, (2) the curved insert in the lower-left area, (3) the curved insert in the lower-right area.
IMPORTANT: the large curved blade along the bottom of the icon is TURQUOISE and MUST stay completely TURQUOISE, including its pointed left end and every part of its top face. Do not add any colored patch, gradient or accent to it. There must be EXACTLY THREE accent-colored components total, one per white insert. Restore perfect threefold repetition of the color scheme.
Keep the original opaque dark graphite background. No text, no other edits, no new objects. Preserve the crisp clean smooth edges and beautiful 3D volume.
Recolor the three white inserts to vivid hot coral-orange #FF6552 with vermilion side faces and peach highlights. Strong saturated color across each insert's whole surface, preserving its original shading and sculpted depth.
